title: Excellent and easy to use.
text:
Excellent and easy to use.. This air mattress filled up firm in 2 minutes and 30 seconds. It had no leaks I turned the big round knob, pressed the on switch and it deflated completely in 3 minutes and 30 seconds. No problems at all.

I love the fabric on the surface, much better than just plastic.

I love that it is all self contained. There is even a spot for the attached cord to store on the mattress. No misplacing items.
